newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Bergesen in talks to buy two VLCCs.
newsitem.headline: Bergesen in talks to buy two VLCCs.

text.p: Norwegian shipping group Bergesen DY ASA on Thursday said it was negotiating an agreement to purchase two VLCCs from Esso Societe Anonyme Francaise for a total price of $25 million.

Bergesen said in a statement that Esso Societe Anonyme Francaise would charter back the vessels at fixed rates until they were 25 years old. The vessels, built in 1974 and 1976, would continue to have French flags.
"The proposed deal is being discussed with French government authorities and is subject to completing the consultation process with ESAF Works councils," Bergesen said.
"Assuming final agreement is reached, both contracts would be effective in early 1997. The total purchase price is $25 million," it said.
